title: The Big Pie
checkpoint: Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sound 'ie' (the /igh/ sound as in pie, tie and lie)
note_for_grown_ups: A Phase 5 book for the new sound 'ie' — another way to write the /igh/ sound your child knows from 'high', used in pie, tie and lie. Every other word uses sounds from Phases 2 to 4.

pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar beside a pie easily four times his size, standing on his back legs to see over the crust. Comic scale.
The pie cut open to show deep purple plum filling, glossy and rich, steam rising. Make it genuinely mouth-watering.
Nell hovering over the pie taking a small neat bite from the very edge, being polite about it. Fig watching.
Both of them mid-mouthful, faces smeared purple, eyes shut in bliss. Close-cropped and joyful.
Fig lying flat on his back beside the mostly-eaten pie with an enormously round middle, all legs in the air. Very funny.

pages.text: Nell put a tie on Fig.
pages.illustration: Nell carefully arranging a tiny bow tie made of ribbon around Fig's neck while he lies there, too full to object.
Fig standing up wearing the tie, striking a dignified pose, still purple-mouthed. Nell applauding with all six legs.

pages.text: Fig and Nell had pie all day.
pages.illustration: Closing page: the empty pie dish, the two of them asleep in it like a bed, tie still on Fig. Golden evening light.
